purpose: Freeze a fresh-root, append-only evidence writer whose accepted output passes the existing Mem-Gallery reconciliation core and whose failures remain immutable.

root_contract.scope: The output root must be an absent, non-symlink exact child of one explicitly supplied /data1 or /data2 project run scope; tests use a temporary explicit scope only.
root_contract.collision: Any existing path rejects before mutation.
root_contract.overwrite: Every non-JSONL evidence file is created exactly once through link-based no-replace publication.

start_contract.first_evidence: Create the fresh root, four empty append-only streams, immutable RUNNING run-record.json, and one STARTED event before any model or endpoint side effect.
bound_identity: dataset semantic identity, QID order SHA-256, question-index SHA-256

append_contract.order: Each terminal scenario's prediction QIDs must equal the next exact slice of the frozen global QID order.
append_contract.denominator: Prediction and retrieval-trace cardinalities must match the scenario question count.
append_contract.prediction: Every row must use agentenhance.memgallery_prediction.v1 and the run method/seed identity.
append_contract.call: Only actual final_answer calls may appear; each must bind a scenario QID, method, seed, accepted/failed state, attempts=1, and retry_count=0.
append_contract.durability: Flush and fsync every append before emitting the SCENARIO_APPENDED event.

terminal_acceptance.precondition: Observed QIDs equal the full frozen order exactly.
terminal_acceptance.identity: Write one reconciliation-compatible TERMINAL_RAW_COMPLETE run-identity.json with the protected Qwen model, temperature 0, max output 128, frozen source and memory budget, and official_values_used=false.
terminal_acceptance.summary: Record prediction, trace, final-answer-call and failed-prediction counts with scores_observed=0 and cleanup_authorized=false.
terminal_acceptance.inventory: Hash the immutable start record, terminal identity, summary, all four JSONL streams, then create TERMINAL_RAW_COMPLETE.
terminal_acceptance.reconciliation_proof: A synthetic terminal output is passed directly into scripts/reconcile_memgallery_method_run.py::reconcile and accepted with the exact denominator.

terminal_rejection.rule: On controller-caught failure, preserve every appended byte, record error type/text and retained row count, hash the partial evidence, and create TERMINAL_REJECTED.
terminal_rejection.recovery: A rejected root cannot be finalized or reused. Any justified recovery requires a separately frozen successor root.

covered_invariants: complete accepted root, hashes, denominator and failed-row count
incomplete finalization followed by retained terminal rejection
call identity and retry drift rejection
direct acceptance by the existing reconciliation core

next_gate: Wrap this writer and the control runner in a separately frozen filesystem lifecycle controller that verifies Wave 1 release, accepted data evidence, exact offline model/tokenizer inventories, exact service receipt, 20 scenarios, 1711 QIDs, time/disk/GPU ceilings, and a lifecycle-only authorization before invoking any real component.
authorization: This synthetic writer stage authorizes no real run root, dataset access, tokenizer or model load, embedding, endpoint request, prediction, scoring, result admission, claim, SOTA language, or cleanup.
explicitly_prohibited: creating or reusing a real server run root from this library without a successor controller
editing JSONL or terminal evidence after append
finalizing an incomplete, duplicate, missing, extra, or reordered QID surface
using an accepted process exit without the hash inventory and terminal marker
deleting a rejected or partial root
